description: This file provides utility functions for MIME type handling, including functions to identify JSON, XML, and textual MIME types, as well as a function to get MIME types based on file path extensions. It also contains a comprehensive map of file extensions to MIME types.

methods.name: isJsonMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a given MIME type string matches common JSON MIME types.

methods.name: isXmlMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a given MIME type string matches common XML MIME types.

methods.name: isTextualMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a given MIME type string matches common textual MIME types.

methods.name: getMimeTypeForPath
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given file path based on its extension, or null if unknown.
